## Checklist

- [ ] `bun test` passes, with both bun and node installed so neither runtime pass is skipped.

- [ ] Docs were updated where behavior or contracts changed; new repo-level or package-level docs are registered in `docs/README.md` or `packages/<pkg>/docs/README.md`.
- [ ] Commits follow the repository convention: a Conventional Commits prefix, one topic per commit.
